{{Season|Summer}} in Stardew Valley |sellprice = {{Price|240}} |iPrice = {{Name|Magma Cap|1}} }} '''Pineapple Seeds''' are a type of seed. Mature plants yield [[Pineapple]]s. They can be purchased at the [[Island Trader]] for one [[Magma Cap]] each. They can also be obtained by using the [[Seed Maker]], as well as having a chance of being dropped from [[Hot Head]]s and Tiger [[Slimes]]. They can also be obtained from [[Golden Coconut]]s.
